claims.claim: Used Nikon D610 in good condition
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 clearly show 'Nikon D810' text on the body, not D610.

claims.claim: May show sign of cosmetic wears
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows scuffing and surface wear on the top plate, and a worn/dusty hot shoe.
No screenshot of shutter count from software (e.g. Nikon menu or shutter-count checker) is shown; LCD shows '-3-' which is unrelated.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Witness reports no lens is attached to the body in any photo, so a lens condition cannot be assessed, and it's unclear which lens this claim even refers to.

claims.claim: Comes with original battery and charger
claims.evidence: No photo of battery, charger, or box/accessories is mentioned in the report.
Internal service history cannot be assessed from exterior photos.

risks.risk: Seller misidentifies the model (D610 vs D810), which could indicate a copy-pasted or mismatched listing, or confusion about what is actually being sold.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the model badge together with the seller confirming the exact model and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced strictly as the witness-confirmed D810 body only, with suspicion flag on listing accuracy.

risks.risk: True shutter actuation count unknown; could be far higher than claimed.
risks.proof: Screenshot from Nikon shutter count checker or in-camera menu showing actuation count.

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, scratches, calibration) cannot be assessed.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of sensor under light, and a test shot against plain white background.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing sensor cleaning/inspection (worst case).

risks.risk: No lens is shown attached; any lens-related claims are unverifiable and lens may not be included at all.
risks.proof: Photo of the actual lens (if any) that will be included, with serial number visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as body-only, no lens included.

risks.risk: Battery, charger, and other accessories not shown; may not be included despite claim.
risks.proof: Photo of battery, charger, and any accessories laid out together with the camera.

risks.risk: Functional faults (autofocus, buttons, dials, memory card slots) cannot be tested remotely.
risks.proof: Video showing camera powering on, autofocus engaging, dials/buttons responding, and a card being read/written.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as untested/for-parts risk on functionality.

risks.risk: Possible internal fungus or electronic faults not visible externally.
risks.proof: Video of lens mount/mirror box under raking light, and a short video of camera operating through several shutter actuations.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming possible internal fault (worst case).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model badge and a video confirming whether it is a D610 or D810, including serial number.
Screenshot of shutter count from Nikon menu or third-party shutter-count tool.
Photo of battery, charger, and any accessories laid out next to the camera.
Close-up photo of sensor under light, plus a test shot on a plain background.
Video of the camera powering on, autofocus working, dials/buttons responding, and a memory card being read.
Photo of the lens (if included) with serial number visible, or explicit confirmation that no lens is included.
response.reason: The seller's description names a different model (D610) than what the witness clearly saw on the body (D810), and references lens condition despite no lens being present in any photo, both strong signs of a mismatched or recycled listing.
